title: Choose the visual world for Peskas Coasts
question: The roll assigned the Tide Table. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Logo, brand colours, sidebar + map layout, 3D effort columns and the dark/light switch stay in every option.

options.label: Tide Table
options.lineage: Printed tide tables and harbour almanacs of the East African coast
options.thesis: Every district reads like a port in the tide tables: a row of monthly figures you can run a finger along.
options.viewport: Navy top bar with logo and three tabs. Left: metric and year, a one-line coverage count, then all 64 districts grouped by country as a table of monthly figures, peak month bold. Right: a light map framed Kenya to Maputo, Timor-Leste in an inset, legend as a printed scale.
options.risk: Dense tables can feel bureaucratic in a meeting if the map stops leading; type must stay large enough for a projector.

raised.raise: Focus dims the rest: hovering a district row or shape dims every other district on the map and in the table.
Every figure carries its source: survey, GPS tracker or census, linked to its method in /docs.
No data is drawn, not left blank: districts and months without data are hatched, never confused with low values.
Census figures in pencil: fishers and boats sit in a lighter tone marked with their census year, since the year filter does not move them.
One size does the work: body text and figures share one size; only page titles step up.
No boxes: rules and spacing group things; no cards, no glow, no nested panels.

options.label: Species Sheet
options.lineage: FAO species identification sheets and fishery fact sheets
options.thesis: Each district reads like a species sheet: its drawn outline, its measured figures, and where each measurement comes from.
options.viewport: White top bar ruled in navy. Left: metric and year, then the selected district drawn as a line outline with dimension-line callouts to catch rate, price, fishers and boats, each naming its source. Right: a white-sea map with hairline coasts and teal districts.
options.risk: Familiar: scientific-sheet white is where most fisheries tools land, and it can read academic and quiet on a projector.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.lineage: Streaming catalogue rows of poster tiles
options.thesis: Districts as rows of poster tiles that grow on focus while the rest dims.
options.viewport: Rows of district tiles per country replacing the sidebar.
options.case: Fuses poorly: fisheries staff do not see their work as a catalogue, and tiles break the pinned sidebar + map layout.

options.label: Monochrome Product Page
options.lineage: Software marketing in one neutral scale
options.thesis: Every claim followed by the interface detail that proves it.
options.viewport: Grey shell, one accent, claim-and-proof sections.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a grey shell with one accent is the corporate dashboard you ruled out, and sells rather than shows.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.lineage: Dance notation read upward along a centre staff
options.thesis: Months run up a staff; fill pattern encodes level, length encodes duration.
options.viewport: A vertical time staff beside the map.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no one in the audience reads dance notation, and an upward staff fights the map.
options.kept: No data is drawn, not left blank.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Ballpoint on ruled inlay, confirmed tracks in ink, tentative ones in pencil.
options.viewport: Handwritten district lists in ruled sides.
options.case: Fuses poorly: handwriting undercuts trust in official figures and has no tie to the coast.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.lineage: Boxed-software manuals with coloured divider tabs
options.thesis: Each section a full-strength hue board under clear acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Stepped tab rail down the edge, one hue per section.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a rainbow of section hues overrides the brand colours, and the audience has no memory of software manuals.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: Giant letterforms morph as an axis slider moves.
options.viewport: A giant figure filling the screen, driven by the year slider.
options.case: Fuses poorly: letterforms are not the subject, and a giant number hides the map.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.lineage: Light data explorers such as Our World in Data
canonCard.thesis: A clean light map explorer, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar of grey controls, light map, legend card, one teal accent.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other data explorers by design, and closest to the corporate dashboard you ruled out.
